model.summary: Anthropic's cheapest, fastest small model ever — ~75% cheaper to run than Haiku 4.5, the first Haiku with an adjustable effort setting, and it beats OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna on Anthropic's benchmarks (OSWorld 2.1: 72.4% vs 48.9%).
